newsletters.subject: The End of Prompting
newsletters.summary: Both Anthropic and OpenAI shipped 'learn by demonstration' features within 5 weeks of each other: OpenAI's 'Record & Replay' in Codex (June 18) and Anthropic's 'Record a Skill' in Claude Cowork (July 21). Claude can now learn a task by watching screen recordings with voice narration, turning demonstrations into reusable slash commands. This marks a paradigm shift from text-based prompting to demonstration-based interaction.
newsletters.notes: Article behind paywall. Core info extracted from metadata and paywall preview. Key insight: Kiana Ehsani (ex-Vercept acquisition) driving Anthropic's demonstration-first UX direction.

newsletters.subject: DeepSeek Answered OpenAI's Price Cut Overnight
newsletters.summary: DeepSeek launched V4-Flash 0731 API public beta with $0.28/M output tokens pricing, directly responding to OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna (-80%) and Terra (-20%) price cuts. Model shows +25.8 Terminal-Bench jump and sits on Pareto frontier for intelligence vs cost per task. Supports Codex/Responses API. Major implications for AI pricing war and competitive dynamics.
